features: Circular SVG timer with animated progress
Start, Pause, Reset controls with accessibility labels
Beep sound using Web Audio API when timer ends
Persistent completed focus session count stored in localStorage with 'pomodoro_' prefix
Responsive design for mobile (375px) and desktop
Dark theme with glassmorphism card effect
CSS variables for easy theming and smooth transitions
fixes: Ensured no console errors on load or after any button press
Handled edge case when localStorage entry is missing or invalid
Prevented multiple intervals by guarding start button
Added ARIA attributes for better screen‑reader support
suggestions: Add customizable session lengths via settings modal
Include long break after a set number of focus sessions
Provide visual notification (e.g., flash) in addition to sound
Allow user to choose a different sound or mute notifications
humanInvolvement: Copy the three files (index.html, style.css, script.js) into the same directory on a web server or local file system. Open index.html in a modern browser. No further setup is required.
